# language-adapter

## Rules

### Unified Interface
- `LanguageAdapter` interface (stateless, synchronous, deterministic):
  - `languages(): string[]`
  - `extensions(): Record<string, string>`
  - `analyzeFile(filePath, content, context: AdapterAnalyzeContext): FileAnalysisDraft`
  - `resolveImports(analysis, context: ImportResolutionContext): ResolvedImports`
  - `buildRelations(analysis, context: RelationBuildContext): readonly Relation[]`
  - Optional: `getPackageIdentity?`, `resolvePackageFromSpecifier?`, `resolveQualifiedNameToPath?`
- Single `analyzeFile` emits complete `FileAnalysisDraft` (symbols, imports, binding/call facts, namespace data). Plain serializable data, NO retained AST/parser trees.
- `TypeScriptLanguageAdapter` default. Unsupported extensions silently skipped.

### Detection & Registry
- `AdapterRegistry`: `register`, `getAdapter`, `getAdapterForFile`, `getLanguageForFile`, `getAdapters`. Dynamic extension mapping.

### Imports, Calls & Scoped Facts
- Extract imports during `analyzeFile`, resolve in Pass 2 via `resolveImports`.
  - TS/Python: relative if starts `.`. Go/PHP: never relative.
- Innermost function/method = caller. Drop top-level calls, unresolved globals, ambiguous/dynamic callees.
- Facts cover scope, typed params/properties, construction, receivers (`this`, `self`, `cls`, `parent`, `super`), deterministic aliases, framework bindings.
- Drop runtime reflection, monkey patching, dynamic paths, ambiguous receivers, interprocedural alias flow.

### Hierarchy & Manifests
- Emit `EXTENDS` (inheritance), `IMPLEMENTS` (contract), `OVERRIDES` (method replacement).
- `getPackageIdentity` searches upward from `codeRoot` bounded by `repoRoot`: `package.json.name` (TS), `pyproject.toml` (Python), `go.mod` (Go), `composer.json` (PHP).
- `resolveImports` uses shared `IndexSession` lookups, not whole-symbol scans or Pass 2 filesystem reads.

### PHP Specifics
- `require`/`include` string literals resolve relative to importer (`IMPORTS`). Drop concatenation/variables.
- Support loader patterns (CakePHP `App::uses`, CodeIgniter `->load->model`, Yii `Yii::import`, Zend `Zend_Loader`).
- Bare & receiver loaders share flow. Drop non-literal/container/unresolved targets; no fallback to file `DEPENDS_ON`.

## Constraints
- Interface stateless; methods synchronous and deterministic.
- Analysis/cache state compact plain data. No parser tree retention.
- Only `getPackageIdentity` & `resolveQualifiedNameToPath` may perform I/O (Pass 2 MUST NOT probe filesystem per candidate).
- Indexer contains NO language-specific resolution.
- Unrecognized extensions / non-deterministic calls / dynamic paths silently dropped.
- TypeScript adapter default.
- No runtime/fuzzy inference; no `@specd/core` dependency.
